text_to_speech: hello my name is Leslie Rosa and I'm running for City Council in Coquitlam which has been my home for over 30 years by profession I'm an educator with the Vancouver School Board I've served also on a number of significant boards I'm a trustee for the BC teachers pension plan which has assets of over 34 billion dollars I'm also a director for Community Savings and they have assets of over 800 million dollars I've also served as a secretary treasurer for the Vancouver Elementary Teachers Association one of the largest in the province my campaign platform revolves around Urban density as the population increases in Coquitlam I'm very concerned that our services keep Pace with population growth the areas I'm concerned about is seniors Parks and Recreation and infrastructure I also want to advocate for housing for seniors families and singles I hope you consider me on October 15th I'd be honored to receive your vote thank you very much

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: Hello, my name is Lessie Rosa and I'm running for City Council in Co-Quitlam, which has been my
home for over 30 years. By profession, I'm an educator with the Vancouver School Board.
I've served also on a number of significant boards. I'm a trustee for the BC Teachers
Pension Plan, which has assets of over $34 billion. I'm also a director for community savings,
and they have assets of over $800 million. I've also served as a secretary treasurer for the
Vancouver Elementary Teachers Association, one of the largest in the province. My campaign
platform revolves around urban density. As the population increases in Co-Quitlam, I'm very
concerned that our services keep pace with population growth. The areas I'm concerned about is seniors,
parks and recreation, and infrastructure. I also want to advocate for housing for seniors,
families, and singles. I hope you consider me on October 15th. I'd be honored to receive your vote.

youtube_description:
Tri Cities Community TV along with the support of The Tri City News (Newspaper) have created short video profiles for each candidate running in the 2022 BC Civic Election.    
This includes 1-minute videos for all Councillor Candidates and 2-minute videos for Mayor Candidates. 
These profiles are our collective efforts to ensure that all candidates have a chance to have their voices heard, promote civic engagement, and to ensure you can make an informed decision when voting on Oct 15th. 
Tri Cities Community TV with the support of its volunteers and grant funding from Canadian Heritage and Telus Optic TV, also offered 30-minute interviews to each candidate.   These 30-minute videos provide a more in-depth overview of each candidate in the 2022 election. 
These videos can be found at the following playlists. 
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4Rlrc2Qa6PBn5vABUkH_sjssJ8yqo88h
https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4Rlrc2Qa6PCp2U8g9wLVfppCrQABXCsv
